title: Animated & Pretty
description: Vanilla Focused Modpack on 1.20.1 with back ported features, Pretty looking visuals and lively Animations!
body:
![Logo](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/60ab10a456d8bb222cb02a4b3af875aa16de8e01_0.webp)
**Vanilla Focused Modpack on 1.20.1 with back ported features, Pretty looking visuals and lively Animations!**

## **Features**

- **🚀 Good performance**
 
> Bundled with Embeddium/Sodium, Radium/Lithium and others, Giving you improved performance compared to default Minecraft.

- **🌍 Multiplayer with Voicechat!**

> This modpack includes E4MC and Voicechat for quick small multiplayer server with friends.

- **✨ Backported features**

> Includes VanillaBackport so you dont miss out on some current minecraft features despite being on 1.20.1!

- **🌟 Pretty visuals and animations**
  
> This pack includes Fresh Animations, Immersive Interfaces and xali's Enhanced Vanilla.

![Village](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/f7621ea364d91c2a39849038b081914d43d59c0d_0.webp)

- **_Make sure you check the settings so tailored to what you need!_**

> 🛠️ Uses Forge so you could build on top of the existing modpack with more mods.

Most of the mods are mostly configable.
